issues.issue: approval_program.summary and citation (line 470) state four primary Phase 3 trials (1489, 1490, 1844, 1878), but only two (1489, 1490) are captured; the two virologically-suppressed trials are missing.

Text attributes the AE rates to 'Trial 1489', but the cited table has four columns spanning both trials/arms, so the mapping of nausea 5% vs 17% to Trial 1489 (comparator ABC/DTG/3TC) is not established by the quote and may mislabel comparator/trial.
The nausea comparator value of 17% is anomalously high versus the other single-digit rates and its column/arm attribution is unverified from the stitched table quote.
